recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the Molecular Definition Data Types IG later receives a stable publication URL, update the links through a separate maintenance issue rather than reopening this applied reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-50878 was an Applied/Persuasive Clinical Genomics change request asking that the MolecularDefinition Boundaries and Relationships section add hyperlinks to the Molecular Definition Data Types Implementation Guide and the relevant profiles, with the final resolution highlighting that the guide is a work in progress.
initial_application: The change was applied before this reconciliation on branch ak-FHIR-50878 and merged by HL7/fhir pull request #3506 in commit 66f7b3563ed9602ba9abdb6cf15cfd0004f8501a. The first-parent merge diff updated source/moleculardefinition/moleculardefinition-introduction.xml to link the Molecular Definition Data Types IG, Sequence, Allele, Variation, Haplotype, Genotype, Observation, and GenomicStudy.
additional_context: FHIR-50576 was the original broader ballot comment and was split so Devices handled DeviceAlert while Clinical Genomics handled MolecularDefinition in FHIR-50878. A committers Zulip thread discussed the caution around linking from core to an in-progress IG; subsequent Clinical Genomics Zulip and Confluence records show the proposed disposition was to add the links while describing the IG as work in progress. The current genomics guidance page also carries the same IG/profile link set.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. source/fhir.ini marks MolecularDefinition active, and source/moleculardefinition/moleculardefinition-introduction.xml already has the requested IG/profile hyperlinks and work-in-progress language.

related_jiras.note: Original broader ballot comment split MolecularDefinition to FHIR-50878 and left DeviceAlert resolution with the Devices work group.
